data.long_meaning: The name Tiffanie is of uncertain origin. It is believed to be derived from the Greek name Theophania, meaning 'manifestation of God' or 'god-shining'. In the English-speaking world, Tiffanie is often interpreted as a diminutive of Theophania, meaning 'pure' or 'god's little one'. The name Tiffanie carries the meaning “Pure, God's little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tiffanie usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, god's little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
